subtitle: 은행에서 달러 환전하기
desc: 시내 은행에서 환율을 확인하고 현금을 환전하는 실전 회화

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Good morning. I would like to exchange some dollars into local currency.
turns.ko: 안녕하세요. 달러를 현지 화폐로 바꾸고 싶습니다.

turns.speaker: Teller
turns.en: Of course. How much would you like to exchange?

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Three hundred dollars. What is today's rate?
turns.ko: 삼백 달러요. 오늘 환율이 어떻게 되나요?

turns.speaker: Teller
turns.en: Today it is one dollar to thirteen thousand two hundred won. There is a small service fee.
turns.ko: 오늘은 일 달러에 만삼천이백 원입니다. 수수료가 조금 있습니다.

turns.speaker: Teller
turns.en: Two percent. You will receive about three million eight hundred seventy thousand won.
turns.ko: 이 퍼센트입니다. 약 삼백팔십칠만 원을 받으시게 됩니다.

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: That is fine. Can I have some small bills as well?
turns.ko: 괜찮습니다. 잔돈도 좀 받을 수 있을까요?

turns.speaker: Teller
turns.en: Yes. I will include ten thousand won notes and some coins.

turns.speaker: Teller
turns.en: Yes, please. Sign here and count the cash before you leave.
turns.ko: 네, 부탁드립니다. 여기에 서명하시고 나가시기 전에 돈을 세어 보세요.

tips.en: I would like to exchange some dollars into local currency.
Can I have some small bills as well?
